title: Pet Rock On A Leash
description: And, of course, don't forget to walk with your <named>cute little pet rock</named> daily! It's quite playful when you let it roam freely, so don't let it loose without the <keyword>leash</keyword>. As the good rock that it is, it'll help you <positive>locate the precious little minerals</positive> around (that it's in no way jealous of and in no way wants them all gone ('◡')) by telling you the exact amount of the <property>ores</property> and their types in the opposite direction of the side of the block you'll rub it on in a <wiggle a=0.5 f=0.5>3x3x60</wiggle> space!
